sections.name: Status
sections.description: Live availability of the monitored services — Gateway API (backend) and Website checks (frontend, via PageSpeed). Segments reflect probe outcomes over the selected window.

sections.name: Health
sections.description: Frontend web vitals measured by Google PageSpeed Insights, plus gateway self-metrics (latency, traffic, error rate, CPU, RAM, uptime).

panels.title: Gateway API
panels.description: Uptime of the tRPC gateway API, one segment per minute over the selected window. Green means healthy, amber degraded, red failing.

panels.title: Website (PageSpeed)
panels.description: Outcome of PageSpeed Insights checks against the configured target URL, one segment per minute over the selected window.

panels.title: PSI performance score (mobile)
panels.description: Overall PageSpeed Insights performance score (0-100) for the configured site, measured with the mobile strategy. Scores above 90 are considered good.

panels.title: Largest Contentful Paint
panels.description: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP): how long the biggest content element takes to render, measured by PageSpeed Insights on mobile. Under 2.5s is good, over 4s is poor.

panels.title: Total Blocking Time
panels.description: Total Blocking Time (TBT): how long the page was blocked from responding to user input, measured by PageSpeed Insights on mobile. Under 200ms is good, over 600ms is poor.

panels.title: Gateway latency
panels.description: Average gateway response latency per minute, in milliseconds. Lower is better; investigate sustained upward shifts.

panels.title: Gateway requests/min
panels.description: Number of requests the gateway serves per minute. Baseline traffic context for the latency and error panels.

panels.title: Gateway error rate
panels.description: Percentage of gateway requests that returned an error, averaged per minute. Under 1% is healthy, above 5% is critical.

panels.title: Gateway CPU
panels.description: System CPU utilization of the gateway host, sampled every 10 seconds via node:os and averaged per minute. Amber past 70%, red past 85%.

panels.title: Gateway RAM
panels.description: System memory utilization of the gateway host, sampled every 10 seconds via node:os and averaged per minute. Amber past 70%, red past 85%.

panels.title: Gateway uptime
panels.description: System uptime of the gateway host in seconds (os.uptime), sampled every 10 seconds and shown as the latest value.

panels.title: PSI audits
panels.description: Dense table of every Lighthouse audit numeric value from the latest PSI run for the configured target URL (mobile), one row per audit id.
